exact_missing_items: Add a minimal command-classification / normalization contract to the command-definition layer: `command_kind` (shell_view | navigation_wrapper | domain_action); optional `normalization` with `kind` (wrapper | deprecated_alias) and exactly one target field: `normalizes_to_contract` for wrappers OR `alias_of_command_id` for deprecated aliases
Keep wrapper metadata contract-level and narrow: point to the canonical primitive family; do not restate route payload structure there
Deprecated alias metadata should remain explicit and separate because it implies lifecycle/removal expectations that wrapper commands do not have.

Extend `GATE-010` to verify: wrapper commands marked as normalizing to the same primitive do not diverge in handler semantics unexpectedly; deprecated aliases resolve to real canonical command IDs; normalization metadata is internally consistent with the command kind
Navigation should follow the same pattern instead of claiming a hard flag day.

existing user-facing wrapper commands may remain; their payload semantics should normalize through `route_target` / `OpenSubject`; older payload shapes can be accepted during migration; new producers/docs should emit the canonical normalized target model
new docs/producers MUST prefer canonical route-target forms; consumers MAY accept older wrapper-local payloads during migration; migration aliases MUST NOT become permanent parallel canon
Reuse the event-alias and recovery-command migration style as the template for navigation normalization.
